image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a vintage comic book cover. The cover features colorful, hand-drawn illustrations of various characters in dynamic poses, typical of superhero or action genres. There is bold, stylized title typography at the top, though some letters appear distorted or nonsensical. Speech bubbles and caption boxes are visible within the panel layout. The paper appears to have a slight sheen, consistent with glossy comic book stock. The spine on the left shows signs of wear and staple binding.

artifact_observations.location: Top title banner and various caption boxes
artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title text reads as nonsensical letterforms ('HACK...'). While stylistic distortion is common in comics, these letters lack coherent linguistic structure and exhibit melting/fusion artifacts typical of AI generation failing to render specific fonts.
Facial features are indistinct and 'mushy'. Hands lack clear finger definition, appearing as fused blobs rather than distinct digits. This is a common AI artifact in complex illustrative styles.
Some background lines (building windows) warp inconsistently. Limbs of background characters merge into the background or other bodies without clear occlusion boundaries.

Anatomical correctness of hands and faces in the illustration style.
Consistency of panel borders and perspective lines.
Edge sharpness between foreground characters and background elements.
